study.question: Does the click-AUC loss after summary-only product-VJP mean removal persist when its per-example latent gradient norm is restored, or can native-direction norm rescaling explain it?
study.hypothesis: The history-summary branch needs the native product-VJP direction beyond its magnitude. In r0066 summary-only removal lost 0.0005276579733013 AUC versus native, query-only lost 0.0001865528657051, and both lost 0.0006891973087417. Since removal precedes multiplication by q, it changes both direction and the norm of ds=(v-mean(v))*q. Restoring the native norm after that multiplication should still underperform the native-direction cell at that norm if direction is consequential. Conversely, recovery by restored removal together with degradation by native rescaling would support a magnitude explanation. These are competing local explanations; neither is established. No new forward architecture is claimed.

nearest_work.difference: Primary archived text lines 269-336 inspected: target-conditioned unnormalized history pooling and Dice are inherited in adapted field/task form. The experiment changes only a specified first-order summary-product backward edge in a later task-specific context/history residual. It is not an exact DIN reproduction or a DIN effectiveness claim.

Authorized original https://arxiv.org/pdf/2508.11565v1 abstract/introduction pages 1-2 inspected directly because registry detailed text is unavailable. INFNet uses categorical/sequence/task tokens, cross attention with proxies and type-specific gated units. This experiment retains the existing compact task adapter and changes one backward branch; no proxies, PGUs or iterative broadcast are added. Broad novelty, full original-paper audit and author/benchmark equivalence remain unverified.

Pinned 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d benchmark lines 204-313 inspected: hub aggregation, normalization and gated broadcast. This is external architecture context, not a matched local control. No benchmark modules or padding leakage behavior are adopted.

Earlier joint-branch restoration AUC 0.6678232418102927 did not repair joint removal; native-direction shrink AUC 0.6683426659245074. Those pre-product joint interventions confound the two branches. The proposed suite keeps dq=v*s native and matches ds norms AFTER q multiplication, only on the summary branch.
Read receipt and accessible source. Raw summary-only removal is retained as a same-suite bridge; add two post-multiplication norm controls and native bridge, with no learned capacity change.

inherited_components: Exact g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer forward and module initialization, via available r0066 standalone source.

study.proposed_difference: For v=J_RMS(q*s)^T g, keep dq=v*s. Compute N=v*q and R=(v-mean(v))*q in FP32. Cross summary direction with per-row L2 norm: native=N; removed=R; removed_restored=unit(R)*||N||; native_rescaled=unit(N)*||R||. Normalize with max-absolute scaling before squaring. When a source direction has zero norm, borrow the other vector at the requested norm (restored falls back to N; rescaled to R), without epsilon or ratio cap. All four derivatives execute in all cells; no change to trained forward, objective, data, resource ledger or score.
predictions: Direction hypothesis: native_bridge exceeds summary_restored at native norm, and native_rescaled exceeds summary_removed at removed norm on full-validation click AUC.
Magnitude alternative: summary_restored recovers toward native_bridge while native_rescaled follows summary_removed. Partial or crossed effects imply interactions rather than a unique explanation.

Native bridge should reproduce r0066-native_bridge and incumbent metrics within justified host numerical tolerance; removed bridge should reproduce r0066-summary_removed. Failure prevents attribution.
All four cells have identical parameter counts and inference graph; custom backward costs may differ from original and must be measured. No efficiency improvement is predicted.
falsifiers: If restored removal matches/exceeds native at the same norm and raw removal matches/exceeds native rescaling at the other norm, a useful native-direction advantage is unsupported for this implementation.
If restoring norm fails to recover and native rescaling does not reproduce the loss, a magnitude-only explanation is falsified locally.

Any forward/state/module/RNG mismatch, nonfinite derivative, wrong task/source gate, failed native/raw bridge, or local norm identity failure invalidates interpretation until resolved with charged host checks.
If no variant exceeds the incumbent at justified measured cost, retain the incumbent; an attribution result alone is not predictive improvement or a new unified architecture.
alternative_explanations: Per-row latent norm matching does not match history-projection parameter or sparse accumulated gradients, optimizer steps, or global dense clipping.
All four task summary branches are intervened on together; this suite does not isolate task-specific contributions.
Training trajectories diverge; equal local norms refer to counterfactual derivatives at each cell's current state.
Zero direction fallbacks preserve the requested norm but cannot identify a direction effect on those rows.
Single frozen seed and many adaptive validation queries; no significance or generalization claim.
Projected summary VJP is a surrogate derivative rather than the derivative of a changed forward function. Effects can be optimization-specific under one pass and dense clipping.
Latent coordinates rotate as representations learn, so a coordinate mean is not an invariant semantic feature.
Auxiliary AUC tradeoffs and target/category/brand label semantics can explain disagreement with primary click selection.
